ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against OFAC Special Designated Nationals list, United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, European Union restrictive measures, and Panama's national UAF and border-control lists. Enhanced customer due diligence is required for politically exposed persons and any ultimate beneficial owner holding 25% or more. The compliance file must document risk rating, source-of-wealth review, adverse-media checks, and the registered agent's mandatory reporting obligations under Law No. 23 of 2015 and UAF Resolution No. 093 of 2017.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Plataforma de Reserva de Nombres (Servicio Electrónico en www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Latin script. A foreign name or brand must be transliterated or romanized into Spanish-compatible characters. The name must end with the Panamanian corporate designation 'Sociedad Anónima' or abbreviation 'S.A.'; names carrying a foreign suffix such as 'LLC', 'Corp.' or 'Inc.' are not registered without conversion to the statutory Panamanian S.A. designation.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Panamá used as an exclusive or generic token without Registry authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30-day period by filing through the same electronic portal before expiration. If the Registro Público rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file an administrative motion for reconsideration, the recurso de reconsideración, before the Directorate of the Registro Público within five business days of notification. The motion must include evidence of the requested name's availability or prior legal authorization. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may pursue administrative-litigation review before the competent judicial tribunal within the statutory filing period following final administrative exhaustion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for the statutory registered agent's address and service of process, provided the agent maintains a physical Panamanian address and accepts service. A virtual office does not by itself satisfy commercial substance requirements once tax registration and invoicing commence. The company must retain physical filing premises, accounting records, and business documentation in Panama or accessible to the Dirección General de Ingresos.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this non-licensed ISIC 3240 cosplay prop and apparel manufacture activity. Estimated less than 5% annual risk of an unannounced physical inspection absent triggering events such as inconsistent registries, adverse sanctions flags, or sectoral AML review.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 32 of 1927 (General Corporation Law), as amended, particularly Articles 1, 2, 5, 10–12, and related provisions of Law No. 18 of 2013 (Public Registry Regulatory Law)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section (Mercantile Registry of the Public Registry of Panama)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; one or more shares may be issued at a nominal value. No escrow account requirement applies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation issue and accept subscription for one hundred (100) ordinary common shares, at par value of one United States dollar ($1.00) per share, fully paid and non-assessable. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation be established at the address of the registered agent in Panama City, Republic of Panama, and that the licensed agent listed in the charter is appointed as resident agent. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the following persons are appointed as officers: [Name] as President, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers are authorized to execute contracts, open bank accounts, and take all lawful actions to complete the incorporation and commence business activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panama Public Registry – Electronic Reservation Platform (Sistema Electrónico de Servicios del Registro Público)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File an online application for corporate name availability, providing first, second, and third choice names; pay the search fee; obtain a reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment (registry search fee receipt)
Copy of applicant’s passport or ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, submit alternate names; the Public Registry shall issue a written refusal; applicant may file a reconsideration appeal within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Circuit of Panama (Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the draft articles of incorporation and bylaws to the notary along with identification documents of all subscribers and the resident agent; incorporate all parties execute the deed before the notary; obtain a certified copy of the protocol.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation and Bylaws
Passports or residence IDs of all incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies defects, correct the draft and re-execute the deed; any modifications shall be made by addendum before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Incorporation Stamp Tax and Registry Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) / Banco Nacional de Panamá – Revenue Collection
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Calculate the incorporation registration tax based on declared capital, pay the required stamp tax at an authorized bank, and obtain a stamped receipt for submission to the Mercantile Registry.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of the public deed
Stamp tax payment form (Impuesto de Timbre)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax assessment is incorrect, file a written recalculation request; any underpayment shall be settled with interest before registry submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration in the Public Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized public deed, tax payment receipt, and fiscal stamps to the Mercantile Section; the Registry examines the documents, enters the corporation into the register, and issues the Ficha and Certificate of Registration.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of registry fees and stamp taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a 'reparo' (objection), the Registry officially notifies the applicant; the applicant must respond in writing within ten business days. Amendments may be submitted by notarial addendum.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Activation and Municipal Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama (Alcaldía de Panamá) / DGI / MITRADEL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct the statutory first board meeting, adopt the board resolution, open corporate ledgers, execute officer sworn declarations, obtain the RUC (tax identification number) from DGI, and apply for the municipal Notice of Operation (Aviso de Operación).
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration and Ficha from the Public Registry
Lease contract or ownership title for the operating premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal applications may be corrected online within three days; if no officer is physically present, a consularized power-of-attorney must be produced.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no sector-specific industrial license for low-impact theatrical costume tailoring; the general municipal operating permit is required
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Notice of Operation (Aviso de Operación) and RUC tax registration

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of Panama (Ministerio de Ambiente – MiAMBIENTE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full EIA; Category I registration is required only where industrial activity releases wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste above household scale
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Panama wastewater discharge parameters per Executive Decree No. 1082 of 2003; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions limited to 20 mg/m³ under national air-quality standards; hazardous waste handling must comply with MiAMBIENTE regulation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection approved by the municipal building department; occupational health and safety clearance issued by MITRADEL prior to commencement of operational activities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, effective through the online portal 'Tributos Digitales' / 'Sede Electrónica' at dgi.gob.pa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima must first be created by public deed and registered in the Registro Público (Public Registry), with a resident agent and local legal representation. To obtain the statutory RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) for income and ITBMS purposes, the corporation or its duly notarised representative must file the DGI registration application through the 'Tributos Digitales' portal or in person at DGI offices, submitting the corporate certification, registered address, director/officer details, and a Panama bank reference. In parallel, the company must obtain the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' (business operation notice) from the local municipality and, if it employs staff in Panama, register with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box system. A Panamanian S.A. is automatically subject to corporate income tax on Panama-source income only. Optional regimes include the SEM (Multinational Company Headquarters) regime under Law 41 of 2007, which requires qualifying regional-headquarters activity, minimum local employment, and investment thresholds. Taxpayers also retain the standard election to attribute direct and indirect costs to Panama-source versus foreign-source income for territorial allocation, and may apply DGI-approved transfer-pricing and treaty elections where relevant. No pass-through election is available to a Sociedad Anónima.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (ITBMS – Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold. Registration for ITBMS is mandatory for any person, whether Panamanian resident or non-resident, that makes taxable transfers of movable goods or services in Panama, including e-commerce sales delivered to Panamanian buyers. Foreign suppliers of digital services and remote products are required to register under the simplified non-resident electronic registration procedure with no minimum threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing for all VAT/ITBMS-registered taxpayers under the DGI's 'Facturación Electrónica' system. Billing software must be homologated with DGI and integrate through DGI web services/API for real-time validation and transmission of invoices. Invoicing data is exchanged digitally and each final invoice bears a unique serial code and QR code; there is no physical fiscal stamping. This applies to both local sales and export evidence packages.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to actual export of movable goods from Panamanian customs territory, including cosplay apparel, prop costumes, synthetic wigs, and licensed theatrical costume merchandise, provided the seller is registered with DGI and the documentary evidence establishes that ownership and risk of loss pass to a foreign buyer outside Panama. Services physically rendered in Panama but linked to exported goods may also be zero-rated. Deliveries to Panamanian domestic customers remain subject to ITBMS at 7%. The export zero-rating claim is allowed to be recognised on the ITBMS return only when the goods have physically left Panama and all customs and payment evidence are retained.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera de Exportación – DUA Exportación) filed with Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment from Panama to the foreign consignee
Inward remittance certificate or bank SWIFT payment confirmation evidencing collection and/or receipt of export proceeds from the foreign buyer
Commercial invoice, packing list, purchase order, and certificate of origin (where applicable)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and ANA cross-match DUA export declarations against ITBMS returns and shipping manifests. Any false documentation, misdeclared destination, circular shipment, or absence of actual foreign payment will result in immediate reversal of the zero-rating, subjecting the exporter to the 7% VAT, late-payment surcharge, interest, and fines under the Panamanian Fiscal Code (including penalties of up to 200% of the omitted tax). Fraudulent export zero-rating schemes are treated as tax fraud and may trigger criminal prosecution, imprisonment, debarment from exporting privileges, and joint liability of responsible directors and legal representatives.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) — the sole integrated banking regulator under Decree-Law No. 2 of 2008. Panama has no note-issuing central bank; Banco Nacional de Panamá is the state-owned commercial bank and fiscal agent. The U.S. dollar is full legal tender pursuant to Executive Decree No. 90 of 1904, and the Balboa (PAB) exists only as a nominal unit of account at a fixed 1:1 parity with USD.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates full de jure dollarization with no exchange-control regime, no central-bank conversion licensing, and no current- or capital-account restrictions. Capital flows, foreign direct investment, profit repatriation, and dividend remittances are fully convertible and unrestricted. Under the territorial tax system, income arising outside Panama is not Panama-source; dividends paid from foreign-source profits are not subject to Panamanian dividend withholding, whereas distributions from Panama-source taxable profits attract a flat 10% dividend withholding tax (Law 8 of 2010, as amended). Because this S.A. will sell cosplay and theatrical apparel cross-border and settle in USD, no currency conversion is required at any stage of the inbound or outbound flow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panamanian law imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no balance-of-payments filing for export receipts. The S.A. may retain export proceeds indefinitely in USD or any freely convertible currency, subject only to ordinary bank-level source-of-funds verification and record-keeping under SBP Acuerdo No. 1 de 2014 (AML/CFT) and the supervision of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF).

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High with strict compliance guardrails. Stripe and Shopify Payments are not directly domiciled or regulated for a Panamanian S.A., so cross-border card volume must be routed through a supervised Panamanian payment facilitator or sub-merchant sponsor (e.g., a PCI-DSS Level-1 local acquirer or an SBP-licensed remittance/payment services company). Offshore digital EMI accounts (e.g., Wise Business, Payoneer, Airwallex) may legally hold USD or CNY balances for settlement, but they are not Panamanian deposit-taking institutions and do not benefit from deposit insurance or bank-grade creditor priority; funds held with EMIs must be contractually ring-fenced and screened against SBP OFAC and PPLS sanctions lists. Final integration: domestic Tier-1 account for operational settlement plus an EMI sub-ledger for Stripe/Shopify payouts.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SBP customer-due-diligence rules (Acuerdo No. 1 de 2014) generally require an in-person KYC interview of at least one director or, in certain banks, the principal account signatory. Tier-1 institutions such as Banco General and Banco Nacional de Panamá mandate physical appearance at a branch or before a Panamanian notarizing attorney holding an apostilled power of attorney from the non-resident directors. Remote opening is available only at select banks (e.g., Towerbank, Multibank) through a documented video-conference interview of the ultimate beneficial owner, combined with notarized corporate documentation, apostilled identity records, and an original certified copy of the corporate registry excerpt (Registro Público). Fully remote onboarding without any interview or local legal counsel is not accepted in Panamanian banking practice.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque beneficial-ownership chain or nominee director arrangements in the Panamanian S.A.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized UBO registry declaration under Law 23 of 2015 (as amended), certified share register and ledger, apostilled passport copies of directors and shareholders, sworn source-of-wealth statement, corporate resolution designating the economic beneficiary, and a clean World-Check/OFCAC/PPLS screening report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsubstantiated capital injection exceeding source-of-funds thresholds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trailing 12-month bank statements of the contributing shareholder, signed capital subscription agreement, board resolution approving aumento de capital, notarized source-of-funds letter, and the SWIFT narrative 'Capital contribution / Aporte de capital' matching the S.A.'s constitutional documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border card-not-present (CNP) e-commerce settlement and elevated chargeback exposure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Chargeback ratio below 1.0 percent, PCI DSS v4.0 Report on Compliance, merchant underwriting file, MCC 5699 alignment, refund and compliance policy, signed payment-facilitator agreement (Stripe/Shopify sub-merchant relationship), and 12-month transaction register exported for audit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Economic-substance and territorial-tax mismatch for manufacturing and retail activities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Lease agreement for registered production or warehouse space in Panama, payroll records and CSS/IVSS contributions, supplier contracts for fabrics and synthetic wigs, Panama customs export declarations, commercial invoices, and bills of lading or airway bills evidencing physical goods movement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or PEP matches on non-resident shareholders or downstream buyers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified UBO and PEP screening sheets signed by the appointed compliance officer, negative OFAC/UN/EU/PPLS matching reports, a transaction-level sanctions-screening log, and a sworn declaration of the commercial rationale for each cross-border payee.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections settle in USD via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 messages through the bank's U.S. correspondent chain (typically Fedwire/CHIPS via JPMorgan, Citibank, or Bank of America) into the S.A.'s Tier-1 Panamanian account. Panama imposes no capital-account registration or foreign-exchange approval; the bank internally records the credit as 'aportación de capital' against a notarized board resolution and updated share register. Recommended protocol: instruct the remitting bank to include the free-format narrative 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION / APORTE DE CAPITAL — S.A. [legal name]', obtain an MT199 covering message where requested, and pre-deliver a signed subscription agreement for any related-party transfer exceeding USD 50,000. Settlement completes in one to two business days with full UETR tracking.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade payments to cosplay apparel suppliers (mainly China-based fabric, wig, and trims vendors) use two primary rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 open-account remittances with UETR for advance T/T (30-50 percent prepayment, balance on presentation of bill of lading) and (ii) commercial documentary letters of credit issued by the Panamanian bank under UCP 600, payable at sight or by acceptance, with SWIFT MT700/MT710/MT754 message flows. For domestic payables and payroll, the local ACH Panama (S.A.C.H.) rail is used in USD. Cross-border disbursements should always designate correspondent charges for the account of the beneficiary ('OUR') to preserve the full gross amount for the seller. Merchant-card receivables from Stripe/Shopify are batched by the local payment facilitator and swept to the operational account via ACH or MT103.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla deliverable CNY/USD FX forwards (OTC, tenors 1-12 months, executed through the bank's offshore or international desk)
CNY/USD non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-convertible tenors where physical CNY clearing is unavailable
USD/CNH cross-currency swaps to align multicurrency trade receivables with CNY supplier payments
Covered at-the-money FX options (simple, non-leveraged, requiring an ISDA Master Agreement and collateral posting)
Natural hedge via USD-denominated trade contracts and intra-group multicurrency netting

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax (Tasa Unica Anual) payment and accreditation of good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direccion General de Ingresos (DGI); payment accredited to the Registro Publico de Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through March 31 of each year, covering the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus 1% monthly moratory interest; failure to pay for three consecutive years triggers statutory dissolution and strike-off of the S.A. from the Registro Publico.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaracion Jurada de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direccion General de Ingresos (DGI) via E-Tax 2.0 portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A., due March 31 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of up to 25% of the tax due plus 1% monthly moratory interest; DGI may embargo bank accounts or withhold the legal standing certificate (Paz y Salvo) of persistent defaulters.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) record update and annual re-validation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Resident Agent; database maintained under the Registro Publico de Panama (Law 254 of 2021, as amended)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 working days after any change in shareholding or control; annual re-validation conducted at franchise-tax renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to B/.5,000 per non-compliance event; denial of good-standing certificates and blocking of registry certificates requested by the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Maintenance and physical availability of statutory corporate registers and minute book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate registered office / resident agent; subject to inspection by the Registro Publico and DGI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous obligation; registers must be updated concurrently with each corporate act and remain available at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Irregular or missing registers may cause rejection of corporate filings by the Registro Publico and expose directors to personal liability for resulting damages.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No automatic statutory audit for a private, unregulated Sociedad Anonima under Law 32 of 1927. Independent audit by a Panamanian licensed CPA becomes compulsory when DGI designates the entity as Gran Contribuyente, when annual gross income or assets exceed approximately B/.1,000,000 under DGI practice, for regulated financial, insurance and securities licensees, and for companies holding State contracts under Law 22 of 2006. A cosplay costume and prop apparel manufacturer selling via Stripe and Shopify Payments generally remains below these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by Panama's Technical Accounting Standards; IFRS for SMEs permitted for non-public-interest entities; books must be kept in Spanish and expressed in Balboas (pegged 1:1 to USD), prepared on the accrual basis.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each shareholder must notify the resident agent in writing of any direct or indirect ownership change within 15 working days. The resident agent updates the UBO register and re-validates it annually with the shareholders at franchise-tax renewal. The UBO file must reconcile with the Register of Members and must never remain blank; shareholders holding the S.A. directly and individually simplify this confirmation process.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registro de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Accionistas y de Junta Directiva)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential corporate tax deductions exist for cosplay apparel producers. The territorial regime exempts foreign-source income; expenses directly attributable to foreign-source revenue remain non-deductible against Panama-source income. Export activities may deduct documented warehousing, freight, and shipping costs when title transfers abroad.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 202 (Declaración Jurada de Rentas de Personas Jurídicas) submitted through the DGI e-Tax portal (Sistema E-Tax de la Dirección General de Ingresos)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (Form 202); quarterly advance income tax payments filed with voucher Form 125
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due within three months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, no later than 31 March. Quarterly advance declarations due on the 15th day following each calendar quarter end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts, less returns and discounts; inclusive of cosplay costume, wig, robe and accessory sales invoiced to retail customers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Panama-source receipts. Physical sales with delivery inside Panama are taxably sourced. Sales where title and risk pass to the foreign buyer outside Panama are excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panama-source sales revenue: production or manufacture conducted, and first commercial delivery made, within Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include sales fulfilled from Panama warehouses or production sites. For cross-border e-commerce, include only sales delivered to Panama addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source revenue exempt under Article 451 of the Código Fiscal.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Classify Shopify/Stripe sales delivered to non-Panama locations as foreign-source, and retain shipping documents, customs records, and payment processor settlement reports to substantiate the exclusion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses incurred in the production of Panama-source income: raw materials, labor, packaging, local logistics, and overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents operating through a documented Panama S.A. may claim expenses directly supporting Panama operations. Intercompany service charges require transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted net taxable income after applying loss carryforwards (maximum five years).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero if no Panama-source income is generated; attach a territorial income analysis showing excluded foreign revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax at the 25% statutory rate: Box 9 multiplied by 25%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an S.A. with only foreign-source income, enter zero. The DGI may require an explanation letter and supporting evidence of offshore destination of sales.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits and quarterly prepayments applicable against the annual ISR liability.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot claim personal credits on this form; any withholding tax on dividends is borne at the shareholder level.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing imposes a surcharge of 10% on the tax due; monthly default interest of 1% accrues on unpaid tax. Erroneous or false returns trigger an additional fine of up to 25% of the omitted tax, an automatic audit assignment, and suspension of the S.A.'s right to engage in notarial or commercial registry transactions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on distributions paid out of profits not subject to corporate income tax; 5% on distributions paid out of profits that were already subject to the 25% ISR.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A shareholder invoking a Panama double tax treaty must provide a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority and a completed DTA relief form to the Panamanian withholding agent. The payer must verify beneficial ownership and minimum holding period when applicable, then withhold at the treaty rate or apply for exemption under the relevant DTA article. TRCs must be apostilled or legalized as required by the treaty and approved by the DGI before lower withholding is applied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding: interest on Panama-source loans at 12.5%; royalties for intellectual property or similar intangibles used in Panama at 15%. Under Panama's treaty network, interest may be capped at 5% and royalties at 10% where the beneficiary qualifies; foreign-source royalties for IP exploited entirely outside Panama remain exempt under the territorial principle.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File are mandatory when aggregate related-party transactions exceed USD 2,000,000, which equals USD-denominated Panamanian balboas; documentation must be available within six months after the fiscal year-end and submitted to DGI on request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama applies economic substance expectations through Law 254 of 2021 and FATF/beneficial ownership standards. A cosplay apparel S.A. must maintain a registered office, a physically present administration, staff or qualified agents, accounting records, and commercial reason for the transaction. Lack of substance will cause foreign-source revenue to be re-characterized as Panama-source and trigger transfer pricing and dividend withholding audits.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Reporting internet cosplay costume revenue as foreign-source while manufacturing, warehousing and delivery all occur inside Panama; suppressing Shopify/Stripe revenue from the DGI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of 25% of the omitted tax plus monthly default interest; criminal tax evasion penalty of up to five years imprisonment and monetary penalty of USD 50,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved or signed the false declaration are subject to civil restitution, seizure of personal assets, travel bans for tax debts above USD 50,000, and temporary disqualification from serving on boards of Panamanian companies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Panama S.A. with nominee directors, no physical premises, no employees, no inventory, and routing overseas retail proceeds through unrelated payment processors with no commercial explanation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative dissolution of the S.A., fines up to USD 10,000, loss of the territorial tax exclusion, and inclusion in the public beneficial ownership registry enforcement list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are jointly liable for unpaid ISR and penalties and may be banned from holding corporate office for two years; foreign beneficial owners face exclusion from banking channels and criminal liability for misuse of the corporate form.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Consistent cash deposits of costume retail sales into the S.A. local bank account without coherent cost-of-goods, VAT, or payroll ledgers; failure to file the annual beneficial owner return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines imposed by the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) up to USD 1,000,000; bank account freezing; revocation of company registration if the beneficial owner is non-compliant.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil liability for disguising the actual shareholder’s identity, plus imprisonment of up to three years under Law 23 of 2015 where the concealment facilitates money laundering.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Cross-border related-party purchases of wigs, foam props, or sewing subcontracting services without preparing or filing the Panama Local File and Master File above the USD 2,000,000 threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty equal to 1% of the aggregate intercompany transaction amount, capped per Panama TP rules, together with an upward adjustment of taxable income; interest applies to the adjusted tax debt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false transfer pricing affidavits or materially misleading comparability analyses are personally liable for the resulting tax deficiency and civil restitution; criminal proceedings arise if the document is used to evade tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing e-commerce profits from Panama-source sales to foreign shareholders without applying the statutory 5% dividend withholding tax, or paying untaxed foreign profits without the 10% withholding and required annual information return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Collection of the unpaid dividend withholding tax plus a 10% surcharge, monthly default interest, and disqualification of the distribution for tax purposes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate directors act as statutory withholding agents; failure renders them personally liable for the withheld amount and penalties, with the S.A. denied future dividend payment registry until the debt is settled.
